reviews.comment: Good prof overall. Structure of the class is clear and has thorough in-class examples. Clear about what will be on the test. Not very understanding when you don't get something simple but willing to answer questions. HW is out of the textbook and gives almost daily quizzes so attendance is a must. I would take him again though
Very clear expectations, grading criteria, and explanations of the material. Very straight-forward and sometimes funny. Quizzes Daily.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Yu is very organized and teaches the material methodically. He has fill-in-the-blank notes which you can use on the quizzes (every class). His tests are pretty straightforward and problems are similar to the ones on the notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Yu is a pretty cool dude who will make fun of his students a bit, but definitely wants you to succeed. He gives you fill in the blank notes that will cover everything that could possibly be on the test and he lets you use them on his quizzes, which are every lecture. His exams will never have material you haven't seen, but the questions are crafty
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is very hard, but Yu outlines the material in easy to understand "fill in the blank" style notes. If you go to class and pay attention to all the examples, it will be very similar to what you see on the test. Be warned: there is a quiz almost everyday, but if you pay attention in class they should be easy.

Expect a quiz in every class. Study lecture notes for tests. His English isn't the greatest, but it's not too hard to follow. He was nice with the group project he was required to assign. I wasn't a fan of the fill-in-the-blank lecture notes,  though.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This teacher was very fair with homework and grading. Gave easy quizzes in class if you paid any attention and the homework was short and fairly simple to do. He posts his powerpoints online (but he still writes a lot of notes on the board). He is friendly and gives extra credit if you answer questions in class
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class was very hard and he was not good at explaining things. Whenever we asked questions, the answers often left us more confused. Thermodynamics is hard but he made it harder.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
